# The framing rows of MANIFEST.txt whose condition docs/SPEC-TABLES.md §6.5
# lists as DECIDABLE FROM THE WIRE ALONE: each is refused, and a port's
# wire-alone walk may be the only thing that refuses it (§6.5, DETECTION
# ORDER IS FREE). A port's walk control reads this file, states only its
# exceptions (rows its typed read also refuses, each with a reason), and
# requires exactly the rest to read with the walk off. internal/wirealone
# reads it and holds every row to MANIFEST.txt (FORMAT.md, WIRE-ALONE.txt).
#
# <class> <framing row>

# the id table: a repeated, unknown, unreferenced or out-of-first-use id
id-table frame_repeat_last_wins
id-table frame_unknown_id_length
id-table frame_unknown_id_reference
id-table frame_unreferenced_entry
id-table skipped_ids_out_of_order

# bytes left inside an array, keyed array or map L after its elements
inert-bytes array_L0_inert
inert-bytes array_L1_inert
inert-bytes keyed_L1_inert
inert-bytes map_L1_inert

# an element kind no reader can skip, under any count
element-kind array_elem_kind_16_count_1
element-kind array_elem_kind_31_count_1
element-kind array_elem_kind_32_count_2
element-kind array_elem_reserved_count_0
element-kind array_elem_unassigned_count_0
element-kind array_elem_zero_count_0

# a nesting depth past the binary bound of 128, inside unknown bytes too
depth depth_arrays_129
depth depth_keyed_129
depth depth_tables_129
depth depth_tables_5000
depth depth_union_tables_65
depth union_chain_unknown_deep
depth union_chain_unknown_past_bound

# the node table's framing, and a record typed by a reserved id
node-table node_table_twice
node-table node_record_bytes_after_terminator
node-table node_unknown_to_fixed_reader
node-table node_type_node_table_id
node-table node_type_build_version_id
node-table node_type_vocabulary_id

# the pointer graph: a cycle or an unreachable record
graph varevo_cycle_known_via_unknown
graph varevo_cycle_root_via_unknown
graph varevo_cycle_two_unknowns
graph varevo_cycle_unknown_self
graph graph_unknown_type_self
graph graph_unknown_type_pair
graph graph_listnode_unknown_self
graph graph_unknown_to_root
graph graph_unknown_type_unreached
graph graph_string_blob_unreached

# one blob record named from two slots
blob-shared graph_blob_two_unknown_fields
blob-shared graph_blob_two_unknown_elements

# ill-formed text in a string blob only an unknown field reaches
text graph_string_blob_ill_formed
text graph_string_blob_zero_byte
